2	// once per committed PC; the controller decides via the trigger map whether
3	// to drain state and returns the populated hybrid_state_v1 if so. The
4	// caller (simulator.hpp) is responsible for writing the file and exiting

22	template<typename Trigger>
23	class HandoffController
24	{
25	public:
26	  // scratch_gpa (L26): forwarded to StateDrain for the V dump sweep; defaults
27	  // to the unset sentinel (non-V drains never read it). The simulator passes
28	  // the real mmap-top-page GPA. caps: the target core's Andes-CSR support,
29	  // forwarded to StateDrain so the drain re-read skips CSRs the core lacks.
30	  HandoffController(Trigger trigger, DmiBus& bus,
31	                    uint64_t scratch_gpa = kVScratchGpaUnset,
32	                    AndesCaps caps = AndesCaps::all())
33	      : trigger_{std::move(trigger)}, drain_{bus, scratch_gpa, caps}
34	  {}
35	
36	  // Snapshot of the QEMU 1 input state. When set, drain merges FP/CSR/V
37	  // fields from the snapshot into the freshly drained GPRs+PC, avoiding
38	  // a per-field DM Abstract Command on every handoff.
39	  void set_passthrough_input(hybrid_state_v1 input)
40	  {
41	    passthrough_ = input;
42	  }
43	
44	  auto on_retire(uint64_t pc) -> std::optional<hybrid_state_v1>
45	  {
46	    const auto hit = trigger_.lookup(pc);
47	    // Only EXIT drains; entry is QEMU's job, vsim ignores ENTER.
48	    if (!hit || hit->kind != HYBRID_HANDOFF_EXIT)
49	      return std::nullopt;
50	    if (passthrough_)
51	      return drain_.drain_with_passthrough(*passthrough_);
52	    return drain_.drain();
53	  }
54	
55	private:
56	  Trigger trigger_;
57	  StateDrain drain_;
58	  std::optional<hybrid_state_v1> passthrough_;
59	};
